posts.title: We should be looking at the cause of somatic cancer mutations in Bernese Montain Dogs
posts.description: By Carol Beuchat The Bernese Mountain Dog is one of the breeds with high risk of cancer that often takes the dog in its prime. Searches for causal genes have not been productive, so breeders ae left with making breeding decisions based on pedigree relationships or DNA tests with low specificity or predictive value. posts.title: A potential cause of idiopathic seizures in dogs
posts.description: By Carol Beuchat PhD Slow whelping caused by of uterine inertia is common in dogs. It can stretch out a process that should take only an hour or two to many hours or even days. Prolonged labor is dangerous for a puppy making the transition from fetus to air-breathing animal, because once the placenta is detached from the wall of the uterus, the puppy no longer has a source of oxygen and can be exposed to low oxygen levels or even run out of air entirely.
